metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location): - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water (Monthly History "JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory") gives monthly water occurrence layers (water = 2, land = 1) - Dates: March 2018 and 16 March 2019 (use the 2019-03-01 layer for the day since Monthly product) - Location: small box over the Elkhorn–Platte confluence prairie just west of Omaha 2. Masking strategy: GSW has quality flags built-in; no clouds to mask for surface-water product. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Sum of water pixels per year = proxy for total open-surface-water area - If either year returns None, NaN, or negative → C3 - If layer does not exist → C1 - If layer exists but reducer returns pixel count = 0 → C2 - Otherwise compare: increase in 2019 sum ⇒ print A, else B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define study area (Elkhorn/Platte confluence near Omaha) geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-96.35, 41.20, -95.95, 41.45]) # ~NW Omaha # 2. Get JRC MonthlyHistory surface water layers col18 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory")\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018,2018,'year'))\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3,3,'month')) col19 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory")\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019,2019,'year'))\ .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3,3,'month')) size18 = col18.size().getInfo() size19 = col19.size().getInfo() if size18 == 0 or size19 == 0: print("Missing layer: 2018:", size18, " 2019:", size19) print("C1") exit() img18 = col18.first() img19 = col19.first() # 3. Compute water-pixel totals (water class == 2) sum18 = img18.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo() sum19 = img19.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo() if sum18 is None or sum19 is None: print("Sum invalid:", sum18, sum19) print("C3") exit() count = img18.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo() if count == 0 and sum18 == 0 and sum19 == 0: print("No valid pixels") print("C2") exit() print(f"Mar 2018 water pixels: {int(sum18)}") print(f"Mar 2019 water pixels: {int(sum19)}") if sum19 > sum18: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define study area (Elkhorn/Platte confluence near Omaha)
geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-96.35, 41.20, -95.95, 41.45])   # ~NW Omaha

# 2. Get JRC MonthlyHistory surface water layers
col18 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory")\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2018,2018,'year'))\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3,3,'month'))
col19 = ee.ImageCollection("JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory")\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019,2019,'year'))\
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3,3,'month'))

size18 = col18.size().getInfo()
size19 = col19.size().getInfo()

if size18 == 0 or size19 == 0:
    print("Missing layer: 2018:", size18, " 2019:", size19)
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

img18 = col18.first()
img19 = col19.first()

# 3. Compute water-pixel totals (water class == 2)
sum18 = img18.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo()
sum19 = img19.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo()

if sum18 is None or sum19 is None:
    print("Sum invalid:", sum18, sum19)
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()

count = img18.eq(2).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('water').getInfo()
if count == 0 and sum18 == 0 and sum19 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

print(f"Mar 2018 water pixels: {int(sum18)}")
print(f"Mar 2019 water pixels: {int(sum19)}")

if sum19 > sum18:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
